smartphone.definition: a mobile phone that can run apps, access the Internet and perform many computer tasks

app.definition: a software application designed to carry out a particular task on a phone, tablet or computer

whiteboard.definition: a smooth white board used for writing with erasable markers during lessons or meetings

coworker.definition: a person who works with you, usually for the same employer

burnout.definition: physical and emotional exhaustion caused by prolonged pressure or excessive demands

annual leave.definition: paid time away from work that an employee can take each year

maternity leave.definition: time away from work before and after giving birth

supply chain.definition: the connected businesses and activities that produce goods and deliver them to customers

market share.definition: the proportion of total sales in a market made by a particular company or product

business plan.definition: a document explaining a business's goals and how it intends to achieve them

outsourcing.definition: the practice of paying another company to perform work previously done inside a business

benchmarking.definition: comparing performance or processes with a useful standard to identify improvements

break-even.definition: having income equal to costs, so that there is neither a profit nor a loss

affordability.definition: the extent to which something can be paid for without excessive financial difficulty

purchasing power.definition: the quantity of goods and services that a particular amount of money can buy

fundraising.definition: the activity of collecting money to support a cause, organisation or project

room service.definition: a hotel service that brings meals and drinks to a guest's room

double room.definition: a hotel room intended to accommodate two people

single room.definition: a hotel room intended to accommodate one person

airbag.definition: a safety device in a vehicle that inflates rapidly during a collision to help protect an occupant

driving test.definition: an examination of a person's knowledge and practical ability to drive safely

carpool.definition: an arrangement in which people share a car journey, often to work or school

groundwater.definition: water stored beneath the surface of the ground in soil and rock

heatwave.definition: a period of unusually hot weather lasting several days or longer

biofuel.definition: fuel made from recently living material such as crops or organic waste

wind energy.definition: energy obtained from moving air, usually using wind turbines

toolbar.definition: a row or group of buttons that provide quick access to functions in a software interface

touchpad.definition: a flat touch-sensitive surface used to move a pointer and control a computer

motherboard.definition: the main circuit board connecting the major components of a computer

usb.definition: a standard connection used to transfer data or supply power between electronic devices

bluetooth.definition: a wireless technology for exchanging data between devices over a short distance

cybersecurity.definition: the protection of computer systems, networks and information against digital threats

username.definition: a name that identifies an individual account on a computer system or online service

login.definition: the process of identifying yourself to gain access to a computer system or account

logout.definition: the process of ending an authenticated session on a computer system or account

antivirus.definition: designed to detect, prevent or remove harmful software from a computer

phishing.definition: an attempt to obtain sensitive information by pretending to be a trustworthy person or organisation

troubleshooting.definition: the process of identifying the cause of a problem and finding a solution

debugging.definition: the process of finding and correcting errors in computer software

machine learning.definition: methods that enable computer systems to learn patterns from data to make predictions or decisions

augmented reality.definition: technology that adds digital information or images to a view of the real world

offline.definition: not connected to the Internet or another computer network

social media.definition: online services through which people create, share and respond to content and communicate with others

single parent.definition: a parent raising a child without a partner living in the same household

barcode.definition: a machine-readable pattern on an item used to identify it and retrieve information about it

sales assistant.definition: a shop employee who helps customers choose and buy products

moisturizer.definition: a cream or lotion applied to skin to reduce dryness

personal best.definition: the best result that an individual has achieved in a particular sporting event

fair play.definition: honest and respectful conduct that follows the rules and spirit of a competition

cool-down.definition: gentle activity after exercise that allows the body to return gradually to its resting state
